description: This file contains pytest test cases and fixtures for testing a FastAPI application related to an 'encoder' module. It dynamically imports modules based on Python version, sets up a test client, and tests API endpoints including response validation and OpenAPI schema checks.

methods.name: get_module(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Fixture that imports and returns a module from 'docs_src.encoder' based on test parameters for different Python versions.

methods.name: get_client(mod: ModuleType)
methods.description: Fixture that creates and returns a TestClient instance for the imported module's FastAPI app.

methods.name: test_put(client: TestClient, mod: ModuleType)
methods.description: Tests the 'put' endpoint for updating an item with valid data and checks the response and database state.

methods.name: test_put_invalid_data(client: TestClient, mod: ModuleType)
methods.description: Tests the 'put' endpoint with invalid timestamp data to ensure proper validation error response.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Verifies that the OpenAPI schema generated by the application matches the expected structure.
